title: ROBERT HALF INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Robert Half Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 20, 2026, disclosing amended and restated severance agreements for five Named Executive Officers (M. Keith Waddell, Michael C. Buckley, Paul F. Gentzkow, Joseph A. Tarantino, and Harold M. Messmer). The amendments eliminate provisions that previously provided severance benefits upon voluntary termination following a change in control. The company stated this change aligns severance arrangements with current best practices and market norms.
key_points: Company filed Form 8-K on April 20, 2026 under Item 5.02 (Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements)
Amended and restated severance agreements for five Named Executive Officers: M. Keith Waddell, Michael C. Buckley, Paul F. Gentzkow, Joseph A. Tarantino, and Harold M. Messmer
Key change: eliminated provisions providing severance benefits upon voluntary termination following a change in control
Company rationale: align severance arrangements with current best practices and market norms
Signed by Evelyn Crane-Oliver, Senior Vice President, Secretary and General Counsel
